T008 : ∀ (n m : ℕ) (u : Space n → ℝ → Space m) (q : Space m),
  (∀ (x : Space n) (t : ℝ),
      0 < t →
        (inner ℝ (u x t) (dt u x t) = 0 ∧ inner ℝ (dt u x t) (dtt u x t - lap u x t) = 0) ∧
          inner ℝ (u x t) (dtt u x t) = -‖dt u x t‖ ^ 2 ∧
            (∀ (j : Fin n), inner ℝ (u x t) (duu u j x t) = -‖du u j x t‖ ^ 2) ∧
              (∀ (a : ℝ), dtt u x t - lap u x t = a • u x t → a = ∑ j, ‖du u j x t‖ ^ 2 - ‖dt u x t‖ ^ 2) ∧
                dtt u x t - lap u x t = (∑ j, ‖du u j x t‖ ^ 2 - ‖dt u x t‖ ^ 2) • u x t) →
    ((∀ (t0 : ℝ),
          0 < t0 →
            ∃ C R,
              IsCompact C ∧
                0 < R ∧
                  C ⊆ openBox R ∧
                    (∀ (x : Space n) (r : ℝ), x ∉ C → r ∈ Set.Icc (t0 / 2) (3 * t0 / 2) → u x r = q) ∧
                      volume (box R) = ENNReal.ofReal ((2 * R) ^ n) ∧
                        volume (box R) < ⊤ ∧
                          (∀ (k : ℕ) (x : Space n) (r : ℝ),
                              0 < k →
                                x ∉ C →
                                  r ∈ Set.Ioo (t0 / 2) (3 * t0 / 2) →
                                    iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (Function.uncurry u) (x, r) = 0) ∧
                            ∀ r ∈ Set.Ioo (t0 / 2) (3 * t0 / 2),
                              sectionGood (fun x => density u x r) C R ∧
                                sectionGood (fun x => densityT u x r) C R ∧
                                  sectionGood (fun x => inner ℝ (dt u x r) (dtt u x r)) C R ∧
                                    ∀ (j : Fin n),
                                      sectionGood (flux u j r) C R ∧
                                        sectionGood (fun x => inner ℝ (dut u j x r) (du u j x r)) C R ∧
                                          sectionGood (fun x => inner ℝ (dt u x r) (duu u j x r)) C R ∧
                                            sectionGood (fun x => dx (flux u j r) j x) C R) ∧
        ∀ (t : ℝ), 0 < t → Integrable (fun x => density u x t) volume) →
      (∀ (t : ℝ),
          0 < t →
            (∀ (x : Space n),
                densityT u x t = 2 * inner ℝ (dt u x t) (dtt u x t) + 2 * ∑ j, inner ℝ (du u j x t) (dut u j x t)) ∧
              Integrable (fun x => densityT u x t) volume ∧
                Integrable (fun x => inner ℝ (dt u x t) (dtt u x t)) volume ∧
                  (∀ (j : Fin n), Integrable (fun x => inner ℝ (du u j x t) (dut u j x t)) volume) ∧
                    HasDerivAt (energy u) (∫ (x : Space n), densityT u x t) t ∧
                      deriv (energy u) t = ∫ (x : Space n), densityT u x t ∧
                        deriv (energy u) t =
                          (2 * ∫ (x : Space n), inner ℝ (dt u x t) (dtt u x t)) +
                            2 * ∑ j, ∫ (x : Space n), inner ℝ (du u j x t) (dut u j x t)) →
        (∀ (t : ℝ),
            0 < t →
              ∀ (j : Fin n),
                Integrable (fun x => inner ℝ (du u j x t) (dut u j x t)) volume ∧
                  Integrable (fun x => inner ℝ (dt u x t) (duu u j x t)) volume ∧
                    ∫ (x : Space n), inner ℝ (du u j x t) (dut u j x t) =
                      -∫ (x : Space n), inner ℝ (dt u x t) (duu u j x t)) →
          ∀ (t : ℝ),
            0 < t →
              Integrable (fun x => density u x t) volume ∧ DifferentiableAt ℝ (energy u) t ∧ deriv (energy u) t = 0
